zh: 我们发布了一个深色模式主题，老实说看起来有点像我此刻给你展示的这个，用来做幻灯片和演示。

speaker: Unknown
en: You can do a lot of stuff with it.
zh: 你可以用它做很多事情。

speaker: Unknown
en: But the reason we built it, the use case that it is satisfying is for MCP servers.
zh: 但我们构建它的原因，它所满足的使用场景，是为了 MCP 服务器。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so I want to give you a quick tour of three ways that you can use it, three increasingly sophisticated ways that you can use it in your MCP server.
zh: 所以我想快速给你介绍三种使用它的方式，在你的 MCP 服务器中使用它的三种越来越复杂的方式。

speaker: Unknown
en: The first is to build an interactive tool.
zh: 第一种是构建一个交互式工具。

speaker: Unknown
en: As I showed you at the beginning of the talk, typically an MCP tool is something your agent calls, and the agent gets the result, and you don't get to interact with it at all.
zh: 正如我在演讲开头给你展示的，通常一个 MCP 工具是你的智能体调用的东西，智能体拿到结果，而你完全无法与它交互。

speaker: Unknown
en: So what's the easiest way that we can advance that interactive functionality?
zh: 那么我们能推进这种交互功能的最简单方式是什么呢？

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm going to show you here.
zh: 我在这里给你展示。

speaker: Unknown
en: This is a FastMCP tool.
zh: 这是一个 FastMCP 工具。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's been decorated with a tool decorator, as you can see, and it's just a Python function that returns some information, bearing in mind this information will go to the agent, not the user.
zh: 如你所见，它被装饰了工具装饰器，它只是一个返回一些信息的 Python 函数，记住这些信息会发送给智能体，而不是用户。

speaker: Unknown
en: If we want to turn this into a fully interactive tool with Prefab,
zh: 如果我们想用 Prefab 把它变成一个完全交互式的工具，

speaker: Unknown
en: We're going to make one change.
zh: 我们要做一处修改。

speaker: Unknown
en: Instead of returning a Python dictionary at the end, which will go to the agent, we're going to return a prefab component.
zh: 不在结尾返回一个 Python 字典（那会发给智能体），我们要返回一个 prefab 组件。

speaker: Unknown
en: In this case, it's the data table.
zh: 在这个例子里，就是数据表。

speaker: Unknown
en: This is what I just showed you the docs for a moment ago.
zh: 这就是我刚才给你展示过文档的那个东西。

speaker: Unknown
en: And when we return this prefab component, FastMCP will automatically detect that.
zh: 而当我们返回这个 prefab 组件时，FastMCP 会自动检测到它。

speaker: Unknown
en: It will automatically infer that you, in fact, want to return an MCP app.
zh: 它会自动推断出你实际上想要返回一个 MCP 应用。

speaker: Unknown
en: And it will spin up all the machinery to get the HTML, the JavaScript, the CSS, the render, everything in place so that your user will see a data table.
zh: 它会启动所有必要的机制来获取 HTML、JavaScript、CSS、渲染器，把一切准备就绪，这样你的用户就会看到一个数据表。

speaker: Unknown
en: Here's what this looks like in practice.
zh: 下面是它在实践中的样子。

speaker: Unknown
en: This is using the Goose client, which is an excellent one.
zh: 这用的是 Goose 客户端，它是一个非常出色的客户端。

speaker: Unknown
en: I asked a server that had the function I just showed you, show me the team directory, and what pops up, this would be better as a GIF, I apologize, but what pops up is a fully interactive data table component.
zh: 我问了一个具备我刚才展示的那个功能的服务器，“给我看看团队名录”，然后弹出来的东西——这个做成 GIF 会更好，抱歉——弹出来的是一个完全可交互的数据表格组件。

speaker: Unknown
en: It supports searching and filtering and sorting and pagination and all this stuff, and all it is is what I showed you a moment ago.
zh: 它支持搜索、筛选、排序和分页等等这些功能，而它其实就是我刚才给你展示的那些东西。

speaker: Unknown
en: Just return the data table class and all this will be taken care of.
zh: 只需返回数据表格类，这些就都会被处理好。

speaker: Unknown
en: We can go a step further.
zh: 我们可以更进一步。

speaker: Unknown
en: What if, in addition to the data table, we want to show a pie chart right next to the data table that breaks down this team directory?
zh: 如果除了数据表格之外，我们还想在数据表格旁边显示一个饼图，把这个团队名录做一个分类拆解呢？

speaker: Unknown
en: As you might imagine, very, very, very similar code.
zh: 正如你可能想象的，代码非常、非常、非常相似。

speaker: Unknown
en: Instead of the data table alone, we're now going to import a grid and a pie chart.
zh: 不再只是数据表格，我们现在要导入一个网格和一个饼图。

speaker: Unknown
en: And if you look at the bottom, you'll see that we compose both the pie chart and the data table into a grid very naturally with a context manager.
zh: 如果你看到底部，你会看到我们用上下文管理器把饼图和数据表格非常自然地组合到一个网格中。

speaker: Unknown
en: And this is the result.
zh: 这就是结果。

speaker: Unknown
en: We now get a pie chart next to our data table.
zh: 我们现在在数据表格旁边得到了一个饼图。

speaker: Unknown
en: So this follows a principle that we really try to hold in a lot of our software at Prefect, which is one line of code, one big noticeable change.
zh: 这遵循了我们 Prefect 的很多软件都努力坚持的一个原则，那就是一行代码，一个显著的大变化。

speaker: Unknown
en: We try to keep that complexity incremental.
zh: 我们努力让复杂性保持增量式。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so this satisfies a lot of things that I think are really important about frameworks and DSLs.
zh: 因此这满足了很多我认为对框架和 DSL 非常重要的东西。

speaker: Unknown
en: This is very quickly, because we won't have time to go into it, this is just an example I threw together and recorded of fully client-side interactivity, where all of these controls are linked, stuff's updating, text is updating, values are updating, no JavaScript was written, this is just a couple of classes composed that all have the same attribute assigned, so they all work together automatically.
zh: 这个很快展示一下，因为我们没有时间深入，这只是我随手拼起来并录制的例子，展示完全客户端的交互性，所有这些控件都是关联的，东西在更新，文本在更新，数值在更新，没有写任何 JavaScript，这只是几个类的组合，它们都指定了相同的属性，所以它们自动协同工作。

speaker: Unknown
en: Oh, and I did throw in a quick code example of what that looks like.
zh: 哦，我确实放了一个快速的代码示例来展示它的样子。

speaker: Unknown
en: We have a class called Rx, which, as you may guess, stands for reactive.
zh: 我们有一个叫 Rx 的类，正如你可能猜到的，它代表 reactive（响应式）。

speaker: Unknown
en: If you use these reactive variables, you can just reference them anywhere in your code.
zh: 如果你使用这些响应式变量，你可以在代码的任何地方引用它们。

speaker: Unknown
en: You can format them.
zh: 你可以对它们做格式化。

speaker: Unknown
en: You can make them the name of something, and it will automatically compile into the correct JavaScript implementation.
zh: 你可以把它们作为某个东西的名字，它会自动编译成正确的 JavaScript 实现。

speaker: Unknown
en: The second thing that we can do is a FastMCP app.
zh: 我们能做的第二件事是一个 FastMCP 应用。

speaker: Unknown
en: So if an interactive tool is sort of a one-shot, here's a user interface, and you can interact with it in the client,
zh: 所以如果说交互式工具有点像一次性的一锤子买卖——这里有一个用户界面，你可以在客户端与它交互，

speaker: Unknown
en: A FastMCP app is a full application with a back end.
zh: 那么 FastMCP 应用就是一个带后端的完整应用程序。

speaker: Unknown
en: And in this case, the MCP server is going to be the back end.
zh: 在这种情况下，MCP 服务器就是后端。

speaker: Unknown
en: We don't have time to go through a full worked example in this session, but here's what the code looks like, just to give you a sense of the ergonomics.
zh: 我们没有时间在这个环节里过一遍完整的实操示例，但代码看起来是这样的，让你感受一下它的易用性。

speaker: Unknown
en: We're gonna write a class, which is our FastMCP app, and then we're gonna decorate at least two functions with app.ui, that's the entry point, that's gonna return the prefab components that form the base UI of that application, and then at least one, I guess this is optional, so zero or more,
zh: 我们要写一个类，就是我们的 FastMCP 应用，然后我们要用 app.ui 装饰至少两个函数，那是入口点，它会返回构成该应用基础 UI 的预制组件，然后再装饰至少一个——我想这是可选的，所以是零个或多个——

speaker: Unknown
en: App.tools, and these are essentially back-end methods that you can now reference in the UI.
zh: App.tools，这些本质上是后端方法，你现在可以在 UI 中引用它们。

speaker: Unknown
en: So you could have a button that takes data that the user has entered into a form and sends it to a database using a decorated tool like this.
zh: 所以你可以有一个按钮，把用户在表单中输入的数据，通过这样一个被装饰的工具发送到数据库。

speaker: Unknown
en: One thing that we use and we ship as a built-in component now in FastMCP
zh: 我们使用并且现在作为 FastMCP 内置组件发布的东西之一

speaker: Unknown
en: is an upload component.
zh: 是一个上传组件。

speaker: Unknown
en: So as you can see, because only the agent has access to an MCP server, you can't simply upload a file to an MCP server.
zh: 正如你所看到的，因为只有智能体有权访问 MCP 服务器，你不能简单地向 MCP 服务器上传文件。

speaker: Unknown
en: It has to go through the brain of the agent.
zh: 它必须经过智能体的大脑。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so what ends up happening is a lot of people create basically an upload tool on their MCP server
zh: 所以最终发生的事情是，很多人在他们的 MCP 服务器上基本上创建了一个上传工具，

speaker: Unknown
en: Forget that the agent has to actually call it, and what you end up doing is the world's most expensive copy-paste operation.
zh: 却忘了智能体必须实际调用它，而最终你做的事情就是世界上最昂贵的复制粘贴操作。

speaker: Unknown
en: You give the agent a megabyte of text, the agent retypes it character by character into the MCP, and now, yes, in fact, you have uploaded it, but it's extremely, extremely inefficient.
zh: 你给智能体一兆字节的文本，智能体一个字符一个字符地把它重新打字进 MCP，现在，是的，事实上，你确实上传了它，但它极其、极其低效。

speaker: Unknown
en: So this is a really good use case for an MCP app.
zh: 所以这是 MCP 应用非常好的使用场景。

speaker: Unknown
en: Where you ask the agent to bring up the app interface, you drag a file into it, and now the file bypasses the agent and goes right into the server.
zh: 你让智能体调出应用界面，你把一个文件拖进去，现在这个文件绕过智能体，直接进入服务器。

speaker: Unknown
en: And we've made that a one-liner like this, along with a handful of other useful tools.
zh: 我们把它做成了一行代码，就像这样，还附带了一些其他有用的工具。

speaker: Unknown
en: And is this a GIF?
zh: 这个是 GIF 吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: This is not a GIF.
zh: 这不是 GIF。

speaker: Unknown
en: Or if it is, it's not rendering.
zh: 或者如果是的话，它没有渲染出来。

speaker: Unknown
en: But it would look like this in your client.
zh: 但在你的客户端里它看起来会是这样的。

speaker: Unknown
en: In any client that supports MCP apps, if you ask the agent, I need to upload something, it can now show you this, and you can upload safely.
zh: 在任何支持 MCP 应用的客户端里，如果你问智能体“我需要上传点什么”，它现在可以给你显示这个，你就可以安全地上传。

speaker: Unknown
en: And, most importantly, cheaply.
zh: 而且，最重要的是，便宜地上传。

speaker: Unknown
en: Oh, I do have a GIF.
zh: 哦，我确实有一个 GIF。

speaker: Unknown
en: Never mind.
zh: 没事了。

speaker: Unknown
en: Know your own slides is a good lesson from this talk.
zh: 了解你自己的幻灯片是这次演讲的一个好教训。

speaker: Unknown
en: So here's the agent is now interacting with a file that I just uploaded, that I dragged and dropped.
zh: 所以这里智能体正在与我刚刚上传的、我拖放的一个文件进行交互。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'll make these slides available later if you'd like to see this, or, of course, it's a one-liner.
zh: 如果你之后想看的话，我会把这些幻灯片提供出来，或者，当然，它就是一行代码。

speaker: Unknown
en: You could try it in your servers this afternoon.
zh: 你今天下午就可以在你的服务器里试试它。

speaker: Unknown
en: The last thing that I want to talk about, which is sort of enabled by this architecture, is a fully generative UI.
zh: 我最后想讲的、由这种架构所赋能的东西，是一个完全生成式的 UI。

speaker: Unknown
en: We're just going to skip and let this play while I talk.
zh: 我们就跳过这个，让它在我讲话的时候播放。

speaker: Unknown
en: So this is a very simple demo where I asked Claude, hey, I'm giving a talk on this.
zh: 这是一个非常简单的演示，我问 Claude,嘿，我要就这个话题做一个演讲。

speaker: Unknown
en: Just start streaming the most interesting UI you can come up with.
zh: 直接开始流式输出你能想到的最有趣的 UI。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so it just went.
zh: 然后它就这么开始了。

speaker: Unknown
en: And what it's doing here is we expose the tool.
zh: 它在这里做的事情是，我们暴露了一个工具。

speaker: Unknown
en: That accepts the JSON, the protocol serialization of a UI that Prefab is based on.
zh: 它接受 JSON,即 Prefab 所基于的 UI 的协议序列化格式。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so now as the agent is streaming that information over the wire, we are in real time rendering whatever we've got, healing that JSON and rendering it.
zh: 所以当智能体把这些信息通过线缆流式传输时，我们实时渲染手头已有的内容，修复那个 JSON 并渲染它。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so this was a really cool demo and it was really effective and people like this because now you don't even have to define the UI yourself.
zh: 这是一个非常酷的演示，效果非常好，大家都很喜欢，因为现在你甚至不需要自己定义 UI。

speaker: Unknown
en: All you have to do is use the skill we already ship, share it with your agent so it knows how to write a UI, and off it goes.
zh: 你只需要使用我们已经发布的能力，把它分享给你的智能体，让它知道怎么写 UI,然后它就可以开工了。

speaker: Unknown
en: It can make you whatever you want.
zh: 它可以给你做出你想要的任何东西。

speaker: Unknown
en: There are some clients that have built-in versions of this.
zh: 有一些客户端内置了这种功能。

speaker: Unknown
en: If they have a built-in version, you may prefer to use it by all means, but this may be a way for you to build your own custom approach or limited set of components that are useful to you.
zh: 如果它们有内置版本，你完全可以优先使用它，但这可能是你构建自己的自定义方案、或者一套对你有用的精简组件集的一种方式。

speaker: Unknown
en: Now, a really interesting thing happened when we spun this up.
zh: 现在，在我们把这个做起来的时候，发生了一件很有意思的事。

speaker: Unknown
en: So as I mentioned, originally the plan was for the agent to send JSON over the wire and have it be rendered into this full React application.
zh: 正如我提到的，最初的计划是让智能体把 JSON 通过线缆发送，然后渲染进这个完整的 React 应用里。

speaker: Unknown
en: What we ended up discovering is that the Python representation of a UI is about 70% smaller than the JSON representation.
zh: 我们最终发现，UI 的 Python 表示比 JSON 表示小大约 70%。

speaker: Unknown
en: So we don't do this anymore.
zh: 所以我们不再这么做了。

speaker: Unknown
en: When I recorded this demo with streaming JSON, what we now do is we actually stream the Python over the wire.
zh: 当我录制这个使用流式 JSON 的演示时，我们现在实际做的是把 Python 通过线缆流式传输。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's executed in a sandbox.
zh: 它在一个沙箱中执行。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's turned into JSON on the server, and then that's rendered.
zh: 在服务器上被转换成 JSON,然后进行渲染。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so this has a dramatic, dramatic token efficiency, cost and latency benefit.
zh: 所以这在 token 效率、成本和延迟方面带来了巨大的、巨大的收益。

speaker: Unknown
en: So it would work exactly the same as when I recorded this demo, but this is just one of those things that we've learned on the fly.
zh: 它的工作方式和我录制这个演示时完全一样，但这只是我们边做边学到的东西之一。

speaker: Unknown
en: And it's really fascinating that the Python representation is just that much more compact and ergonomic.
zh: 非常令人着迷的是，Python 表示就是比完整的 JSON 表示紧凑得多、好用得多。

speaker: Unknown
en: Then the full JSON one.
zh: 比完整的 JSON 表示。

speaker: Unknown
en: So that's Prefab.
zh: 这就是 Prefab。

speaker: Unknown
en: If you'd like to check it out, if you're curious, if you want to see the weirdest thing I've ever built, along with however many other people, you can see the docs at prefab.prefect.io.
zh: 如果你想看看它，如果你好奇，如果你想见识我做过的最奇怪的东西之一，和其他许多人一起，你可以在 prefab.prefect.io 查看文档。

speaker: Unknown
en: You can see the full library, which is on our GitHub here.
zh: 你可以看到完整的库，它就在我们的 GitHub 上。

speaker: Unknown
en: And this is already fully baked into Fast MCP.
zh: 而且这已经完全内置到 Fast MCP 中了。

speaker: Unknown
en: So if you're using a recent version of Fast MCP, you should be able to install this optional edition, import the components, return them, and start playing with these MCP apps.
zh: 所以如果你用的是较新版本的 Fast MCP,你应该可以安装这个可选组件，导入这些组件，返回它们，然后开始玩这些 MCP 应用。

speaker: Unknown
en: Thank you all for coming.
zh: 感谢大家前来。

speaker: Unknown
en: Thank you.
zh: 谢谢。
